reason: Provides read-oriented timeline and file-diff visualization for checkpoint snapshots and session logs, with explicit user-triggered workspace rollback and undo operations.

summaries.zh: 将检查点和会话日志转换为时间线及逐文件逐行差异视图，并提供可预览的工作区回滚与撤销功能。
summaries.en: Turns checkpoint snapshots and session logs into timeline and per-file line-diff views, with previewable workspace rollback and undo operations.

capabilities: Reads checkpoint snapshots and session logs
Displays timeline and per-file line diffs
Provides GUI, command, and JSON HTTP interfaces
Writes workspace files during user-triggered rollback
Removes files created by its own rollback during user-triggered undo
